objective: Challenge narrow beauty stereotypes and make beauty a source of confidence rather than anxiety.
businessContext: Brand research reported low self-identification with conventional beauty standards.
strategy: Connect communications, representation and self-esteem programs under a sustained category-relevant mission.
outcomes: Unilever sustained the platform and reported broad participation in self-esteem education.
whatWorked: The issue related directly to category representation.
whatFailed: Company-reported reach and attention do not isolate brand or social causality.
transferConditions: The issue is category-relevant and supported by durable programs, representation standards and operating behavior.
nonTransferConditions: Do not use social purpose solely as a creative theme or ignore contradictions elsewhere in the company portfolio.

sources.title: Making Purpose Pay: Inspiring Sustainable Living
sources.methodology: First-party account of research, program design and reported reach.

economicContext: Growing scrutiny of narrow beauty representation
